sources.entry: Better Launchpad - Customizable app launcher with fast search.

summary.one_liner: Better Launchpad is a free, customizable macOS application launcher with fast search, keyboard navigation, and layout editing.
summary.what_it_does: Better Launchpad is a macOS application launcher intended as a replacement for the standard Launchpad. It provides search that finds and launches apps quickly, and the README says you can start typing an app name to search. Keyboard navigation lets you move through apps with arrow keys and launch with Enter. Layout customization includes drag-and-drop reordering, hiding apps you rarely use, and changing an app's icon. The README also states the app is available in multiple languages and is free and ad-free. It is distributed as a .dmg file for either Intel or Apple Silicon Macs.
use_cases: quickly find and open apps on a Mac
launch apps without using the mouse
reorganize app icons into a custom grid
hide rarely used apps from the launcher
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg from the releases page
Choose the build for Intel Macs or Apple Silicon
Drag Better Launchpad.app into the Applications folder
notable: Keyboard-first navigation: arrow keys to move, Enter to launch, type to search
Drag-and-drop app reordering for a custom layout
Hide apps and change app icons
Free and ad-free according to the README
caveats: The README does not describe system requirements beyond macOS and Intel or Apple Silicon builds
The README does not name a source-code build process or implementation language
The README is brief and includes an empty Screenshots section
